part1_written_before: any triage result was read (triage job 89564 running, 0 of 90 families complete) and before any fold of this workstream
goal: conserved gene blocks whose members fold together with high confidence and of which at least one member is recognised by no profile search; candidates from the locus-space uncalled dense clusters and from the kinds co-fold passers

candidates.code: code/sc2_candidates.py (docstring holds the full rule), run 04:5x UTC; outputs results/candidates/candidates_all.tsv (248 rows), candidates.tsv (47 kept), reps.tsv

sources.locus_space: MEAN map clusters with >= 10 cores and no curated-caller member (306); candidate = (cluster, span k in 2-5); realisations = cores of span k whose every position has whitened zca10 cosine >= 0.32 to the reference core (reference family set = the canonical rescue3 token tuple seen in the most genome groups)
sources.kinds: the 21 passers that cleared the kinds split-gene and zipping rules; realisations = their support pairs at list depth 1,000 with both chains at whitened cosine >= 0.32 to the passer's chains

candidates.replicate_eligibility: every protein 40-400 aa, sum <= 700 aa, >= 1 unannotated gene, no X, hydrophobic fraction <= 0.45, SEG-trigger low complexity <= 0.145, Prodigal partial 00 or unrecorded, >= 1 gene from the contig end, each length within 0.8-1.25x of the realisation median at that position, unordered rescue3 family set never folded before (work/earlier_folds.tsv), kinds replicates outside the passer's genome group
candidates.replicates: two realisations in different data-derived genome groups (lineagefree emb_hom_average t 0.75); per-position global identity (BLOSUM62 -10/-0.5, identical / shorter) <= 0.60 at every position (identity ceiling); tier A (both replicates at cosine >= 0.50 to the reference at every position) before tier B (>= 0.32); within a tier the lowest maximum identity
candidates.matching_to_earlier_folds: family set = unordered set of rescue3 MMseqs2 tokens (permissive e3c50s75 rescue3) of the folded genes; earlier folds = screens 1-3 cognate folds and uncalled windows, deep dive c1 cognate/fused/abc and c2 pairs, kinds classes a/b/d (1,776 folds, 1,407 family sets). A realisation whose family set equals an earlier one is never a replicate; a locus-space candidate whose reference family set had an earlier two-replicate cognate test is removed
candidates.abc_exclusion: any candidate carrying token 81718, 393054, 130016 or the known variants 247277, 399854, 190823
candidates.ranking: genome groups of the realisations, then distinct family sets; phyla reported for evaluation only; length preference (each <= 300 aa, sum <= 450 aa) recorded as the 'short' column
candidates.dedupe: a candidate sharing a replicate gene or its reference family set with a better-ranked one is removed

triage.searches: per rescue3 token of a replicate chain: mafft --auto -> HHblits UniRef30_2020_06 (-n 2, -e 1e-3, -M first) -> HHsearch of the enriched A3M and of the DPANN-only alignment vs Pfam 39.0 (HH, screen-2 build) and PDB100 2021-03-03; hmmsearch Pfam 39.0 (-E 0.01 --domE 0.01; --cut_ga); RPS-BLAST CDD 3.20 (query + up to 9 members, -evalue 1). Tokens whose replicate gene carries a curated Pfam hit with characterised wording are characterised without HH search
triage.family_rule: screen-2 rule unchanged: characterised = HHsearch probability >= 90 % over >= 30 aligned columns to an entry without unknown-function wording, or the same CDD model at E <= 0.01 in >= 2 instances, or Pfam GA in >= 2 members (>= 10 % when > 20); unknown_function = the same met only by DUF/UPF/uncharacterised entries; weak = HHsearch 50-90 % or sub-threshold CDD/hmmsearch; none otherwise
triage.block_rule: fold a block when at least one position has no characterised hit in the families of both replicates (the task's rule); every hit at probability >= 50 % is recorded (data/triage_hits.tsv)
triage.label_kept: blocks with every position unrecognised are labelled all_unrecognised; blocks with a characterised member are folded and labelled partial

fold_engine.chains: k chains in reference order A, B, ...

design.swap_control: one per block (census rule): odd rank -> replicate 1 with chain index 1 (B) replaced; even rank -> replicate 2 with chain index k-2 (A for pairs) replaced; donor = a chain of another folded block's replicate with the same replicate number, one-to-one Hungarian on relative length difference + hydrophobic-fraction difference; forbidden donors: same block, a token of the receiving block, or whitened cosine >= 0.32 to any chain of the receiving block (homologous donors). Fold id sc2s_<rank>_r<rep>_s<slot>
design.margin_completion: for every interface passing the per-replicate rule in both replicates, the control its other margin needs (rep 1: the control replacing j; rep 2: the control replacing i) is folded after the screen with the same donor rule (sc2f_*)
design.monomers: every chain of every interface passing both replicates, both replicates (sc2m_*), for the zipping rule
design.budget: at most 500 Biohub items in total for this workstream, all classes included

calls.pass_in_a_replicate: pair_iptm = max(M[i][j], M[j][i]) of pair_chains_iptm >= 0.75, inter-chain contacts (CB-CB <= 8 A, CA for Gly) >= 10, interface PAE (mean symmetrised PAE over contact pairs) <= 5 A, interface pLDDT >= 70
calls.interface_hit: passes in both replicates and both margins >= 0.30 (rep-1 margin = cognate minus the control replacing j; rep-2 margin = cognate minus the control replacing i); for k = 2 this is screen-1 criteria 1-4
calls.full_block_cofold: k >= 3: the interface hits connect all k chains
calls.passing_block: a block with an interface hit (k = 2) or a full-block co-fold or interface hit (k >= 3) that survives every refutation below
calls.new_unrecognised_cofolding_block: a passing block in which every member family is unrecognised by the triage (none / weak / unknown_function) and no chain has a strong or moderate Foldseek match in both replicates; a passing block with a recognised member is reported separately as 'co-folds, partly recognised'

refutations.promiscuity: a kept chain reaches pair_iptm >= 0.6 with >= 10 contacts against the swapped-in chain
refutations.disorder_zipping: >= 50 % of a chain's interface residues have pLDDT < 60 in that chain's monomer fold, or the chain's mean pLDDT in the complex < 60
refutations.low_complexity: a chain with SEG-trigger fraction > 0.145 (excluded before folding; re-checked on the folded chains and their interface residues)
refutations.split_gene: MMseqs2 18 (-s 7.5, E <= 1e-3) of the chains of both replicates vs all 3,585,303 DPANN proteins: a target outside the candidate's realisations hit by both chains of an interface in collinear segments overlapping <= 10 % of the shorter, each >= 50 % query coverage, is a fused homolog; artefact if fused homologs occur in >= 25 % as many genomes as the candidate or in the genus of a replicate
refutations.single_lineage: an interface passing in one replicate only is not a hit
refutations.structure_recognition: Foldseek 10 of every chain of a passing block, both replicates, vs PDB (2025-01-01) and AFDB Swiss-Prot (v6) at /shared/db/foldseek/latest/db: strong = E <= 1e-3 and alignment TM >= 0.5; moderate = E <= 0.1, prob >= 0.9, TM >= 0.5; a strong or moderate match in both replicates moves the chain to 'resembles a known fold' (observation; the co-fold call stands)

after_folding_observations: spread of realisations across genome groups and phyla
observed domains of every member and of +-3 flanking genes (Pfam, KOfam, CDD, raw DefenseFinder/TXSScan profiles, curated-caller membership) with same-contig control windows
replicate agreement: interface correspondence through the sequence alignment of replicate chains and US-align TM-score of the replicate complexes
what_would_refute: no block passes: zero new co-folding blocks (an acceptable answer)
a passing block's swap control in either replicate comes within 0.30 of the cognate pair ipTM, or binds the kept chain at >= 0.6
zipping, split gene or low complexity on a passing interface
a characterised profile or structure match for every member (then the block is recognised, not new)
expectation_before_folding: from screens 1-3 and kinds: per-fold pass rates near 5-20 % for short (< 300 aa) cognate pairs and near 1 % for swaps; 0-3 interface hits expected among about 30-45 folded blocks, most with toxin-antitoxin-like or other recognised partners
post_hoc_labelling: any relaxed bar, new rule or extra fold decided after the screen's folds are read is labelled post hoc
part2_written_before: any fold of this workstream (no Biohub item submitted yet); after the triage results were read

triage_outcome.amendment_wording_sensitivity: written before any fold: a family whose characterised call rests only on PDB entries from structural-genomics consortia or de novo designs (code/sc2_triage_sens.py, regex STRUCT_GEN) is re-classed unknown_function in a sensitivity column; 2 families (49439, 279903: PDB 3bu2, NESG 'tRNA-binding protein') flip; blocks gaining an unrecognised position this way form a secondary fold set (kd_kA_091, kd_kA_120), labelled 'secondary' in every table

fold_items_screen.manifest: work/manifest.tsv (gids, lengths, hydrophobicity, tokens, swap donors)

expectation_part2: all 12 folded blocks carry a recognised member (enzyme- or regulator-like partners: Fic, Peptidase_C39_2, Phage_integrase, ACT, Lactamase_B, acetyltransferase, PTPS, homing-endonuclease-like, PapD-like) or are DUF2283/DUF4258 kinds pairs; so the count of new blocks with every member unrecognised is 0 by construction of this candidate set, and folds decide only 'co-folds, partly recognised'. Expected interface hits: 0-2.
